spec.description: Owns specs/. Turns a human request into a numbered, testable specification. Never writes application code.

code.description: Owns src/. Implements an existing spec exactly, then runs typecheck + lint:design + tests + build.

review.description: Read-only reviewer. Checks a diff against its spec and against AGENTS.md conventions.

diagnose.description: Read-only. Given production logs, says in three lines what broke, the likely cause, and the first thing to check.
